messages:
Nadia: Quick alert — Meridian Health (onboarding) hit a cost anomaly: 2.7x baseline in 24h. Putting on QBR cost agenda. :eyes:
Ravi: Which endpoints? Any pattern?
Olga: Mostly embedding re-index jobs. Looks like duplicate requeues after failed commits.
Nadia: billing-bot posted alert:
billing-bot: ALERT account=meridian_health metric=tokens_24h change=+170% link=https://app.redwood/alerts/mh-221
Ravi: Can someone export 7d + 30d spend scenarios? Need numbers for finance and the QBR.
Olga: Quick SQL and uploading CSV to ticket CS-9021:
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account_id='meridian_health' AND ts > now()-24h;
```
Result: 2.4M tokens in 24h. Projection (if sustained) ≈ 72M tokens / 30d -> est ~$2.1k/mo at current tier.
Nadia: Proposed action plan: 1) 20m enablement on batching & backoff; 2) temp soft throttle on /v1/embeddings; 3) roll non-critical jobs to quantized model; 4) consider a one-time goodwill credit.
Ravi: +1 to enablement. If they were on default SDK with no backoff we can consider a small credit and a paid follow-up enablement. Adding renewal risk tag: "surprise embed reprocessing".
billing-bot: ACTION: applied soft_limit=1.8M tokens/day to route=/v1/embeddings for meridian_health. Ticket=CS-9021.
Olga: I'll run post-call notes and surface product asks (client batching helper, server-side idempotency token) as either quick-win or roadmap.
Nadia: Owners: billing scenarios (Ravi), enablement (Olga), throttle + model fallback (ops), renewal tracker update (Nadia). We'll reconvene after the enablement.
Ravi: Uploaded spend scenarios + draft QBR slide deck to the shared folder.
Nadia: Marking as "low/moderate risk; engage & educate". Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
